notes: Ground-floor/low-angle view of the Eiffel Tower against a blue sky, no other buildings visible, no readable text. UNCALIBRATED by design — place names were banned by the description prompt when this entry was added (since replaced by confidence-gated naming, see docs/findings.md), so a baseline run is expected to show near-zero naming until/unless a new prompt clause is tested.
